rows.en: (Mmm, walking in the park feels so nice.)

Hm, is that...
Heeey, Shirakawa~!
(Looks like I kinda startled her...)
rows.notes: x2, player, both genders; passive odorokarete iru = she seems surprised (by me). 'her' = Miyuki in both versions.

rows.en: H-hello. What are you doing here?

I just came out for a walk,
for a change of pace.

Yeah. What about you, Shirakawa?
Out for a walk?
Yes, something like that.
You look kinda down, huh?

There's something I'd like to ask you.
Would that be all right?
What's with the formality all of a sudden...?

Do you ever think about your future,
\p-kun?

My future... Like goals, that kind of thing?
I used to want to be a pilot or a mechanic,
but...
rows.notes: Male; mukashi wa ... atta = childhood dream jobs.

rows.en: What about now?
Now... it's all kinda fuzzy, I guess...

What about you, Shirakawa?
Is there something you want to do?

I...
don't know either.

Don't you want to make your mark as a pilot
or something?

Well... it's not that I don't...
But I only became a pilot for my family's sake...
It's not like I chose it because I wanted to...

Though I think my father wanted me
to become a technical officer...
rows.notes: x2, Miyuki; gikan = technical officer (engineering officer).

rows.en: And now look at you, a full-on hotshot pilot!

Heh heh. Flying through space feels wonderful.
Once you've felt that, you can never forget it...
rows.notes: x2, Miyuki. 'Heh heh.' as her fufu elsewhere (c02236).

rows.en: (Huh, so Shirakawa can smile like that.)
Then isn't that good enough?
You love flying through space, Shirakawa.
rows.notes: Male. The Japanese states it in third person like a premise (Shirakawa likes flying); rendered as direct address, she is the listener.

rows.en: That's why you're a pilot.
rows.notes: x2, player, both genders; continues c10691/c10714 after Miyuki's 'Okay...'.

rows.en: Is that not good enough?
Or is there something else you want to do?
It's not that there isn't anything, but...

You're right. For now, I'll focus on being a pilot,
and I won't slack on the effort that takes.
rows.notes: x2, Miyuki; stated as a resolution to herself.

rows.en: Yeah, that's the spirit!
Hehe...
rows.notes: x2, Miyuki; kusu' (a small giggle). Review: Miyuki's kusukusu/kusu is 'Hehe' (as elsewhere).

rows.en:
I wonder why...
I'm telling you all of this...
Ahaha, well, what's wrong with that?

Y-yes, I suppose so.
Well then, I'll head home first.

(Looks like Shirakawa's feeling better.
Good.)
(Mmm, walking in the park feels nice.)

Hm, is that...
Yoo-hoo, Miyuki~!

I just came out for a walk,
for a change of pace.

Yeah. What about you, Miyuki?
Out for a walk?
Hey, don't you look kinda down?

Do you ever think about your future,
\p-san?

My future... Like goals, that kind of thing?
I used to want to be a nurse or a hairdresser,
but...
Now... it's all kinda fuzzy, I guess...
What about you, Miyuki? Anything?
(Huh, so Miyuki can smile like that.)
Then isn't that good enough?
You love flying through space, Miyuki.
Is that no good?
Or is there something else you want to do?
Hehe, well, that's fine, isn't it?
rows.notes: Female; answers Miyuki's 'why am I telling you this'.

rows.en: Yeah, see you at school.

(Looks like Miyuki's feeling better.
That's great~)
(I came to Central Park with Shirakawa again!)
This is a nice place for a walk, huh?
Yes, it really is...

It's so strange to think
this is all inside the Macross.
rows.notes: x2, Miyuki. 'Macross' kept as in the Japanese (the Frontier fleet/ship); the park is aboard the colony fleet.

rows.en: (I'm glad she's feeling better.)

???
Is there something on my face?
N-no, it's nothing.

???
You're acting weird, \p-kun.
rows.notes: Male; hen na \p-kun, as Akimizu's c03671.

rows.en: Well then, should we head home soon?
Please invite me again, okay?
(Okay, time to go home and take a bath~)
(I came to Central Park with Miyuki.)
This is a really nice place for a walk, isn't it?
(I'm so glad Miyuki's feeling better~)
Nope, it's nothing.

???
You're acting weird, \p-san.
Well then, should we head home soon?
(Okay, time to go home and take a bath.)

uncertain: c10723: 'inside the Macross' kept literal (the Frontier); could be read as the fleet in general.
